dispute.statement: The driver took a longer way round than the app showed. The fare was a fixed quote, but I want the detour looked at.

chat.text: Traffic ahead on Central Expressway is building up, ok if I go round via Ang Mo Kio Avenue 5?

driver_statement: Traffic was building up ahead so I asked the rider before turning off via Ang Mo Kio Avenue 5 and the rider agreed.
